scope: Narrow ordinary TDD repair for loaded finding-ID overflow in new workbench only; original saved IDs and frozen v2 renderer unchanged.
fix: Before each actual Add finding click, a capture-phase listener seeds the unchanged v2 allocator from the first unused small suffix in current case-insensitive IDs. Saved large IDs remain exact; allocation ignores their numeric magnitude.

limitations: Node DOM emulation is not visual or actual-browser validation
